findings.title: Low-privilege issue/triage workflow and release workflow share `actions/cache` keys
findings.evidence: Shared cache key prefix 'mypy|' between .github/workflows/tests.yaml and .github/workflows/tests.yaml
findings.why_it_matters: An attacker triggering a low-privilege issue/triage workflow can poison the shared GitHub Actions cache consumed by privileged release workflows.

findings.title: Missing automated dependency update config (Dependabot/Renovate) and `SECURITY.md`
findings.why_it_matters: Lack of automated dependency hygiene and a vulnerability disclosure policy delays remediation when upstream dependencies are compromised.

improvements.title: Low-privilege issue/triage workflow and release workflow share `actions/cache` keys
improvements.description: Isolate `actions/cache` keys by workflow privilege tier so issue/triage workflows cannot poison release caches.
improvements.snippet:
- uses: actions/cache@1bd1e32a3bdc45362d1e726936510720a7c30a57
  with:
    path: ~/.npm
    key: release-only-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
    restore-keys: release-only-${{ runner.os }}-

improvements.title: Missing automated dependency update config (Dependabot/Renovate) and `SECURITY.md`
improvements.description: Add `.github/dependabot.yml` for automated security updates and a `SECURITY.md` disclosure policy.
improvements.snippet:
# .github/dependabot.yml
version: 2
updates:
  - package-ecosystem: "github-actions"
    directory: "/"
    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
